name: SkeletonAvatar
statusNote: Alpha in Primer React. A SkeletonBox with Avatar's size and shape rules.
summary: A shimmering placeholder of an Avatar's exact size and shape, shown while the avatar's data loads. Pair it with SkeletonText for a loading list row.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Size in px, or {narrow, regular, wide}, as Avatar.

inputs.name: square
inputs.description: Rounded square instead of a circle, as Avatar.

anatomy.name: Shape
anatomy.description: A size by size circle (or rounded square) of --skeletonLoader-bgColor, with no ring.

layout.text: The placeholder is an inline size by size box (default 20px) with a 50% radius, replacing SkeletonBox's block display, 16px height and small radius.
Square: radius clamp(4px, size - 24px, --borderRadius-medium): 4px at 28px and below, 6px at 30px and above.
A responsive size switches at the same viewport ranges as Avatar: narrow below 768px, regular from 768px, wide from 1400px.

states.text: Shimmers as skeleton-box (1000ms repeating mask sweep, off under reduced motion).

behaviour.text: Not interactive; it takes the same space the Avatar will, so swapping one for the other does not shift layout.

semantics: Nothing is exposed; the loading region should carry aria-busy or a status message.

notes.text: SkeletonAvatar has no 1px ring, while Avatar draws one outside its box; the swap is therefore not pixel-identical at the edge, though the layout box is.
Its size and shape rules override SkeletonBox's only because its stylesheet loads after SkeletonBox's (equal specificity); a native build simply uses the avatar geometry.
